shared_elements: procession/row of figures moving in one direction
low-relief carved figural scene with formalized poses
figures with arms extended forward toward something
justification: Both show profile human figures in formal, repeated poses arranged in a directional file, which is a very generic convention, and A's figures leading horned rams have no counterpart in B. B is dominated by a rayed disc worshipped by flanking figures beneath an arched top with cartouches, plus many horizontal registers of dense script, none of which appears in A's single large-scale animal-leading procession.
